name: 02382 · Whitman, MA
findings: ZIP 02382 (Whitman) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02382 (Whitman) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02382 (Whitman) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
